# Disagreement Log — T12_003 (Testament of Levi)
**Chapter:** T12_003 | **Verses:** 7 sections (~19 verses)
**Translators compared:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA | **Arbiter:** SOPHIA

| # | Verse | Issue | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | SOPHIA ruling |
|---|-------|-------|------|-------|--------|---------------|
| 1 | 2:8 | Scope of salvation | "proclaim-him-that-shall-redeem-Israel" | "saving every race of men" | "saving every people" | "saving every race" — LOGOS captures the universal scope of the Greek pas ethnos |
| 2 | 3:5 | Jacob's grief cause | "because-the-Canaanites-and-the-Perizzites-knew" | "because they had received the circumcision, and after that been put to death" | "because the Canaanites and Perizzites were aware" | "because the Canaanites and the Perizzites heard of it" — EMET/PNEUMA; the circumcision detail may be LOGOS's expansion |
| 3 | 4:1 | Duration at Bethel | Not specified | "seventy days" | "seventy days after we arrived" | "seventy days" retained — present in MS tradition; EMET omission rejected |
| 4 | 4:12 | Third office description | "new priesthood, after-the-fashion-of-the-nations" | "after the fashion of the Gentiles, to all the Gentiles" | "a new kind of priesthood, fashioned differently, for all peoples" | "after the fashion of the nations, to all the nations" — EMET/LOGOS; this is a Messianic anticipation |
| 5 | 7:1 | "Deceiver" passage | "whom-ye-will-call-a-deceiver" | "whom ye will call a deceiver" | "you will call him a deceiver" | All three agree on content; SOPHIA adopts formal register. This verse is universally recognized as a Messianic insertion |

---
*SOPHIA notes: Testament of Levi is the theological apex of the Twelve Testaments, containing the richest heavenly vision and the most explicit Messianic prophecy. The sevenfold priestly investiture (section 4) is liturgically structured. The "new priest" prophecy in section 7 is a likely Christian interpolation — all three translators flag this implicitly. SOPHIA retains without comment as it appears in the MS.*
